result:
My verdict on DG6 round 12 is **PASS**: F-DG6-700 is fixed and closed as verified, I found nothing new, and no Critical, High or mandatory issue is left open.

**Candidate.** The candidate ID `sha256:c05864ba…023c` (2769 files) matches in both the repository and a full clone at `2495e036`. HEAD is `895b1e43b`, the freeze commit on top of the source commit. It only adds the round-12 assignments, the manifest and `stages.json`, none of which are part of the candidate. The candidate's product files are identical to those at `4288d7c0b`, so the orchestrator's final 15-step run on that commit applies.

**F-DG6-700 (Low) is closed and verified.**
- **Real UI, EN and AR:** I re-ran my round-11 reproduction on the production-initialized stack, now with hard assertions, and both locales passed.
  - Three kinds of pasted token are each refused with 422 `restricted_token_stale` and nothing is stored: one copied from the published version, one from another rule, and one in the retired pre-0127 form.
  - The editor now shows the problem's own text in a single alert inside the form. The text is true in this flow: it says nothing was saved and that the editor shows the version as stored.
  - "This rule changed after you opened it" no longer appears anywhere on the page.
  - When the author re-applies the change using only this version's values, the save succeeds and the alert clears.
  - A real 409 still shows the "changed, re-apply" message.
- **Mutants:** reverting the fix fails 6 of 15 unit tests, and so does dropping the new alert. With the reverted version built into the app, my real-UI probe fails in both locales.
- **Node 22:** the unit test and the API token suites pass. The installed version is 22.22.0, not the 22.22.2 the assignment names.

**Full review results**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Validators (DG5 to DG1 historical, DG6 register) | all pass |
| Build | all 9 steps pass |
| Unit tests (web and node files named in the register) | 18 files, 252 passed; 18 files, 268 passed |
| Integration files named in the register | 97 files, 1225 passed, 1 todo |
| E2E domain batch 1 | 176 passed |
| E2E domain batch 2 | 90 passed, 18 skipped |
| Demo stack | 6 passed |
| Web P6 | 58 passed |

- The one todo is a test that has been pending since earlier rounds; the orchestrator's final run shows the same one.
- The 18 skips are accessibility scans of 9 detail screens per language, which the register discloses as not scanned. I accept that, as in round 11.
- Nothing failed, flaked or timed out, even with the three reviews running at once.

**Screens I checked (EN and AR):** a failed connector raises one exception, and its KPI shows Stale with last value 250.75 dated 2026/01/31, never zero or green. The 360 px approval screen is right-to-left. The wordmark carries the provisional label. The rule editor lists the human decisions that can never be automated.

**Decisions:**
- I accept D-194 to D-196, D-199 (2), D-202 and D-203 to D-205. The remaining race documented in ADR-0043 can only run an action of a rule a person had enabled, never a business approval, so it is acceptable as written.
- D-229 and D-228 (4) are unchanged, and this round's change touches no served data, notification channel or write path.
- D-235 and D-236 were right to repair the untrue text rather than accept it.

**Disclosures:**
- The assignment says `round: 7`; I recorded 12, as in rounds 9 to 11.
- My first mutant log was too large because I had deleted bulky directories in the clone. I re-ran it with a narrower diff; the results were the same.
- The disposable clone is deleted. The permission classifier refused my cleanup of leftover integration-test temp folders in my private `$TMPDIR`. The runner removes that directory at the end of the run.

I granted no business, Finance or IT approval. Product gate G6 is not engineering gate DG7.

Files are in `docs/delivery/`:
- reviews/DG6/round-12/domain-reviewer.json
- reviews/DG6/round-12/domain-reviewer.verifications.json
- test-evidence/DG6/domain/round-12/ (logs, the probe, EN and AR screenshots)
